rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to preserve a narrow, institutionally cautious holding: § 1155 revocations are discretionary decisions “specified by statute” and thus barred by § 1252(a)(2)(B)(ii), while leaving open any residual review for colorable constitutional claims or pure questions of law via other jurisdictional hooks. Sotomayor is the most likely dissenter (with Jackson joining or writing separately) to preserve limited legal/procedural review under Kucana’s presumption and the “good and sufficient cause” constraint.
